- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The University of Michigan involves students in research and other academic endeavors outside of the classroom through various programs, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Undergraduate Research Opportunity Program (UROP): Offers research experiences to students across all majors and disciplines, allowing them to work alongside faculty or graduate students and earn academic credit or a stipend.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Multidisciplinary Action Projects (MAP): Provides opportunities for students to work on real-world problems in teams with faculty and industry partners in areas like business, healthcare, technology, and sustainability.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Student Organizations: Over 1500 student organizations available for students to pursue academic interests, offering leadership, networking, and community engagement opportunities.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Study Abroad Programs: Offers study abroad programs in more than 100 countries for cultural exploration and gaining global perspectives.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Internships and Co-op Programs: Collaborates with companies and organizations to provide students with internships and co-op opportunities for real-world experience.
